# Adani Foundation

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **complete**

Adani Foundation (est. 1996) is the CSR/social-welfare implementing arm of the Adani Group, chaired by Dr Priti G. Adani, operating across 22 states / 7,247 villages and reaching a cumulative 13.3 million lives per its own website. It works through five thematic pillars (Education, Health and Nutrition, Sustainable Livelihoods, Climate Action, Community Development) and flagship programmes including Project Utthan, Project Udaan, Adani Vidya Mandir schools, Sathwaro and an Employee Volunteering Program. Group-company sustainability/CSR pages (Adani Power, Adani Ports, Adani Enterprises) describe the Foundation as the entity implementing their CSR-2 spend, giving footprint evidence across Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, Bihar, Tamil Nadu (FY2025-26 Adani Power sites) and Gujarat/Odisha districts under Project Utthan (FY2025-26). A newly announced partnership with the Anushkaa Foundation and National Health Mission on clubfoot care (announced mid-2026, in FY2026-27) was also found. No amount was attributed to the Foundation itself as spender per the research instruction distinguishing it from group companies' statutory CSR-2 filings; company-level figures (e.g. Adani Power FY2025-26 CSR spend: Education Rs.150.24 crore, Community Development Rs.36.35 crore) were seen but deliberately excluded from this Foundation record, and no PAN/CIN/CSR1/Darpan identifier or single named grant amount was found for the Foundation itself. IMPORTANT ANOMALY: both research_goals and funder_dossier calls for 'Adani Foundation' returned data for a completely unrelated organisation, [funder:9] SBI Foundation, instead of any existing Adani Foundation record or a 'not found' response - this appears to be a fuzzy-name-matching defect in the catalog lookup (matching on the shared word 'Foundation') rather than a genuine prior record for Adani Foundation, so no real baseline comparison could be made; all findings saved here should be read as a fresh record for Adani Foundation, not a diff against SBI Foundation's data.

Website: https://www.adanifoundation.org

## What it set out to find

- identity/legal name, website, parent relationship (Adani Group)
- csr_year and csr_spend attributed explicitly to Adani Foundation itself for FY2025-26, FY2024-25, FY2023-24 (distinct from group-company CSR-2 filings)
- footprint: states/districts where Foundation programmes actually ran
- stated priority geography
- partners (NGOs, government bodies, other institutions)
- programs/themes (education, health, sustainable livelihoods, climate action, community development)
- metrics/impact figures
- contacts (office bearers, media/programme contacts)
- supporting documents (annual reports, CSR disclosures)
